title: Coverage Periods and Transfer on Resale — Bridgewell New Home Builder Warranties Homeowner Terms
content:
These terms of Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties state how long each kind of coverage runs and when a warranty passes to a later owner of the home.

## Coverage periods

**Clause 1.** Coverage under the warranty runs in phases from the closing date: workmanship and water penetration defects through the workmanship end date (water penetration for the program's water penetration years), distribution systems through the systems end date, builder-installed appliances for the program's appliance coverage years, and structural defects through the structural end date.

**Clause 2.** The warranty moves to the systems period the day after the workmanship end date, to the structural period the day after the systems end date, and to expired the day after the structural end date.

| Status of the warranty | Runs |
|---|---|
| Workmanship period | From the closing date (once the warranty is confirmed) through the workmanship end date |
| Systems period | From the day after the workmanship end date through the systems end date |
| Structural period | From the day after the systems end date through the structural end date |
| Expired | From the day after the structural end date |

**Hypothetical calendar.** A warranty with a workmanship end date of 14 May 2026, a systems end date of 14 May 2027 and a structural end date of 14 May 2035 is in the workmanship period on 14 May 2026, in the systems period from 15 May 2026, in the structural period from 15 May 2027, and expired from 15 May 2035.

## Transfer to a later owner

**Clause 3.** When the program provides that the warranty passes automatically to a subsequent owner, a resale passes the remaining coverage to the new owner without a fee or new enrollment; phase dates never restart.

**Clause 4.** A warranty passes to a new owner only while it is in workmanship period, systems period or structural period.

Clause 4 is judged on the status shown on the company's record of that warranty before the transfer is made. A transfer records the new owner and the transfer date, which is the date of the resale closing.

| Status of the warranty at the resale | Passes to the new owner |
|---|---|
| Enrollment pending | No |
| Workmanship period | Yes |
| Systems period | Yes |
| Structural period | Yes |
| Expired | No |
| Voided | No |

**Hypothetical resale.** The home in the calendar above is resold with a resale closing on 2 September 2028, while the warranty is in the structural period. The remaining coverage passes to the buyer with no fee and no new enrollment, and the structural end date stays 14 May 2035; it does not restart from the resale.
